title: Autumn Hearth Glow

diffuser.notes: Run 20–30 min in a well-ventilated room; refresh as desired.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; mist linens/air, not skin.

why_it_works: Bright orange lifts the mood while clary sage and cedarwood add a soft, grounding warmth that echoes crisp autumn air.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
